data.title: 猫猫 · 夜市药草茶的闻香
data.description: 【后宫外夜市·傍晚】猫猫穿着外出襦裙，在药草茶摊前端起小杯闻香；她用指尖拨开杯沿的香叶，确认不是可疑配方后才小口品尝，蓝瞳里闪过满意的亮光。
data.location: evening herb market outside the palace
data.action: 夜市茶摊先闻香拨开香叶，确认安全后小口品尝露出满意亮光
data.lighting: warm red lantern light after sunset
data.mood: 药师式的夜市美食勘验
data.promptProse: At the evening herbal-tea stall, Maomao lifts a tiny cup to smell it, then uses one fingertip to move a floating leaf aside before tasting. Her pale-rose blouse and dark-green long skirt remain tidy beside a small cloth bag. The horizontal medium portrait includes neighboring counters beyond her approving blue-eyed glance. Red lantern light warms the cup and sleeve edges, with deeper shade beneath the stall roof and small highlights across the tea.
